annotations.text:
LEADING DIRECTION — dark, atmospheric glass with a drifting mesh background.

Landing (this one) + App (to the right) are the deliverable. Static mockups.
The manual-cut feature lives here: click a highlight to load its range, or drag the two handles to set your own in/out. Queue AI + hand cuts together, render horizontal or 9:16.
ALTERNATE — lighter, centered, calmer, one focal action. Wireframe on purpose. If this vibe wins, Landing gets rebuilt into it.
